warnings.message: 2025-2026 is reused temporal evidence; only a future frozen paper interval can be genuinely unseen.
The 540-name 2026 fallback universe is replayed historically without point-in-time membership or delisting returns.
The effective test spans 2022 through mid-2026 and contains too few independent market regimes for a production claim.
Costs are deterministic per-fill stress assumptions, not a symbol/time-specific opening-auction impact model.
Jensen alpha is SPY/BIL CAPM alpha and does not remove size, sector, or momentum factor exposure.
Historical performance cannot guarantee future returns or alpha.
